untertitel: Do you use a care service and also provide care yourself? Work out how much care allowance is left for you.
erklaerungTitel: How is it calculated? (In plain terms)
erklaerung: The more of the budget the care service uses, the less care allowance is paid into your account. If the service uses exactly 60% of its budget, for example, the care fund pays you the remaining 40% as care allowance.
schrittNutzung: 2. What share does the care service use?
sachleistung: Value of benefits in kind (care service)
pflegegeldRest: Your remaining care allowance (paid to your account)
gesamtwert: Total value of the monthly benefits from the combination:
